query: SELECT name, last_updated, manifest_digest, COUNT(*) OVER() AS "count!" FROM container_registry_repository_tag WHERE repository_id = $1 AND ($2::TEXT IS NULL OR name ILIKE '%' || $2 || '%') AND ($3::TEXT IS NULL OR manifest_digest ILIKE '%' || $3 || '%') AND ($4::TIMESTAMPTZ IS NULL OR last_updated >= $4) AND ($5::TIMESTAMPTZ IS NULL OR last_updated <= $5) ORDER BY last_updated DESC LIMIT $6 OFFSET $7;
